news.title: Today: guided walking tour of Ortigia at 16:45, gala dinner at 20:00
news.summary: Meet at the venue entrance at 16:45 for the optional guided walking tour of Ortigia. Gala dinner at 20:00 at Area M.
news.body:
16:45 – Meeting point: the entrance of the conference venue. The tour is optional: if you prefer not to join, that is no problem.

You will be split into two groups that follow the same walking tour of Ortigia with the guides, 10 minutes apart, to avoid crowding in the small places you will visit.

The tour lasts about two hours. Around 19:00–19:15 you will be left at the Temple of Apollo, a convenient spot from which you are free to do as you like.

20:00 – Social Gala Dinner at Area M (Riva Nazario Sauro 6, Siracusa).

**If you are not joining the tour, meet us directly at the dinner venue.**

For any further information, please ask at the front desk.

news.title: Today's social activities: meet at 16:50, departure at 17:00
news.summary: Please be on time: meet at the conference venue at 16:50. We leave on foot at 17:00 for the Ortigia tourist train and the Opera dei Pupi puppet theatre.
news.body:
Please be on time.

16:50 – Meeting point: the conference venue, Siracusa Urban Center (Via Nino Bixio 1)
17:00 – Departure on foot from the venue

Participants will be split into two groups. One group takes a tour of Ortigia on the tourist trains, while the other attends a show at the Opera dei Pupi, the traditional Sicilian puppet theatre. Then the two groups swap.

The activities end at about 19:45–20:00. Afterwards you are free to go to dinner: we have already sent some suggestions on where to eat by email.

news.title: Welcome Cocktail on 10 November: Piazza Duomo and Kaleido Terrace
news.summary: On Tuesday 10 November participants met at 18:45 in Piazza Duomo, Ortigia, for the Welcome Cocktail at Kaleido Terrace, Via Pompeo Picherali 10.
news.body:
The Welcome Cocktail took place on Tuesday 10 November.

18:45 – Meeting point: Piazza Duomo, Ortigia (Siracusa)
19:00 – Welcome Cocktail at Kaleido Terrace, Via Pompeo Picherali 10, 96100 Siracusa (Ortigia)

Kaleido Terrace is in Ortigia, a short walk from Piazza Duomo. Other venues with a similar name exist elsewhere: use the map link below.

This updates the Welcome Cocktail information in the program.

news.title: Best Paper Awards at every workshop
news.summary: Each NCA 2026 workshop assigns its own Best Paper Award, presented by the workshop organizers at the end of the workshop.
news.body:
Every NCA 2026 workshop has its own Best Paper Award. At the end of each workshop, the workshop organizers will present the award to the best paper of their workshop.

Workshops:
• NetAI 2026 – Tue 10 Nov, Sala B
• AiDDRESS-MED – Tue 10 Nov, Sala A
• ContinuumOps – Tue 10 Nov, Sala B
• DETECT – Tue 10 Nov, Sala A
• STiNCA – Thu 12 Nov, Sala A
• AI-SecureCom – Thu 12 Nov, Sala A
• ICON – Fri 13 Nov, Sala A
• GreenNet-AI 2026 – Wed 11 Nov, Sala A
